Every item forwards to AppModel, ThreadRuntime, WindowManager or Tour, and most chords come from ShortcutStore (user-rebindable), while the nine "Thread N" chords and the four 1.6.2 zoom items are hard-coded Command chords.

files.purpose: AppModel extension that runs Hydra teams: it decides whether a chat leads, which provider/model/effort its heads use (HydraLaunch), creates head threads (native mirrors of provider sub-agents and Droppy-run heads with their own sessions), gives Droppy-run heads an isolated detached git worktree copy of the checkout, and lands their finished work back into the lead's checkout as a three-way applied patch. It also owns the private tree-capture cache shared by heads of one delegation block, the 30-second watchdog that labels quiet heads "Thinking for N min…" and stops stalled ones, stopping/clearing heads, releasing and sweeping worktree copies (keeping unlanded work as patch files), and the chat-context summary handed to queued heads.

HydraTreeCache.capture loop: checks cancellation; a stored capture of the current generation younger than 3 s is reused only if git.currentTree() still equals its tree; joins an in-flight capture of the same generation; otherwise starts git.currentTree() + commitTree; a failed/cancelled capture clears inFlight and rethrows; if the generation changed during the walk the result is discarded and the loop repeats. invalidate clears the capture and increments the generation.

startDroppyHead: loads the heads' provider catalog and default model if the head has no model on a different provider; if stopped while copying, never starts; stamps executionStartedAt = now and executionFinishedAt = nil, then sendHydraBrief.

finishHydraHead: stalled heads get HydraWatchdog.stalledNote prefixed ("Stalled: no edits for 10 minutes; stopped by Droppy Code. Resend with a sharper brief."); status map completed->completed, failed->failed, interrupted->stopped, running->running; copies live activity, max toolCalls, max tokens; with settings.hydraAutoClearFinished, after HydraPanel.finishHold + 0.2 s moves the head out of the panel and clears its panel references; relays to lead runtime hydraHeadFinished with copyPath when info.hasOwnCopy; releases the copy only for auto-clear and outcome .completed.

hydraHeadTurnFinished (Droppy heads only): stamps executionFinishedAt; error = last error-level notice of the closing turn; report = last assistant text (for failed status only non-empty text in that turn); failed report = error or "The turn failed without a recorded error." plus "Partial output before the failure:\n\n<partial>" joined by blank lines; toolCalls = count of tool entries; stops the session unless provider.isAPIKeyBased.

Launch-failure retry: failed status, error matches one of "database is locked", "database locked", "sqlite_busy", "did not start a session", "the agent exited", "stopped unexpectedly" (lowercased contains), no tool entries, fewer than 2 retries, and a user entry exists; pause = attempt * 2 + (index % 4) * 0.5 seconds; resends the first user message as a ComposerDraft unless the head is running or no longer .running. The retry resends through `headRuntime.draft = ComposerDraft(text: brief, attachments: [])` and `headRuntime.send()` (lines 695-696), not through startDroppyHead, so executionStartedAt is not stamped again (lines 522-525 run only in startDroppyHead), and executionFinishedAt, already set to .now at line 638 before the retry decision, stays set while the retried turn runs, until hydraHeadTurnFinished stamps it again when that turn ends.

Landing: only completed heads with their own copy land; skipped if the head is running again; a finished head reporting again is set back to .running before finishHydraHead. If prepareHydraPatch throws, landHydraHead (lines 751-757) returns a HydraLanding with only `landing.error = error.localizedDescription`: no files, no patchPath, no noteHydraLanding call (no note in the lead timeline from landHydraHead) and no landingStartedAt/landingFinishedAt stamps (those are set only in applyHydraHead). finishHydraHead stores that landing (line 591). With landing.error non-nil the head is skipped by hydraUnmergedFileCount (line 289) and by hydraWork (HydraMerge lines 482-483), so its timeline tool edits no longer count toward any merge; and because releaseHydraCopy computes `unlanded = info.status != .completed || info.landing == nil` (line 973), a completed head with such an error landing is not unlanded, so releasing its copy writes no -unlanded.patch before `git worktree remove`.
prepareHydraPatch: base tree vs copyGit.captureTree(); build-output paths excluded before diffing (binary: true); DiffParser off-main; nil when nothing changed.

waitForSettledCheckout: deadline 30 * 60 s; busy when lead phase != .idle and the paths intersect leadRuntime.hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths, or lead isHydraMerging; polls every 250 ms; a thrown sleep (cancellation) returns at once.
Landings are serialised per lead through leadRuntime.hydraLanding chaining on the previous Task.

applyHydraHead: stamps landingStartedAt = now, landingFinishedAt = nil, and defers landingFinishedAt = now (lines 843-844). With an operation in progress (lines 849-854) it keeps the patch (keepHydraPatch), sets error "a rebase or merge is underway in the checkout, or its git state cannot be read", calls noteHydraLanding and returns early, WITHOUT HydraTreeCache.invalidate and WITHOUT noteDiffChanged. Otherwise it applies; baseTree moves to patch.after only when conflicts are empty; apply errors keep the patch with error.localizedDescription; then (lines 867-870) it invalidates HydraTreeCache for the checkout, calls existingRuntime(for: parentID)?.noteDiffChanged(), and notes the landing.

Conflict note: "<Name>'s work landed; the lead is settling a conflict in 1 file|N files." then the backticked files, then "The checkout had moved on where <Name> was working, so the merge was three-way and left markers in this file|these files. files.purpose: AppModel extension implementing Hydra's "Merge when the team is done" auto-merge: it gathers exactly the files a lead and its heads changed, commits a snapshot of them without switching branches, pushes a branch, opens and merges a pull/merge request through the forge CLI (with a dedicated glab path for GitLab), and syncs the checkout's default branch. In 1.6.2 it also arbitrates files contested between chats in the same checkout (reservations vs blocking claims, ordering by lead UUID), records hold/settled/stray/failed/merged outcomes, and posts Hydra notes plus notifications to the lead.

glab path used only when git.forge() == .gitlab and glab is on PATH, else git.createPullRequest. Arguments: ["mr", "create", "--title", title, "--description", body, "--yes", "--squash-before-merge"] + ["--repo", <remote web URL with user/password stripped>] when a host exists + ["--source-branch", source, "--target-branch", target]. Host fallback text "your GitLab host". Pre-check glab auth status (non-zero -> gitLabAuth, empty message -> "glab is not signed in to this GitLab host."); on auth failure re-check and retry once; on output mentioning "recover" retry once with "--recover"; else creationFailed(failureMessage). Detail sources: the pre-check throws gitLabAuth with the `glab auth status` failureMessage (or the fallback text) (lines 395-396, 428-431). If `glab auth status` throws (glab cannot run), hydraGitLabAuthFailure returns nil and creation proceeds. On an auth failure of `mr create`, when the re-check still reports not signed in, no retry runs and gitLabAuth is thrown with the first `mr create` failureMessage; when the re-check is good, one retry runs and, if it fails, `failure = retry`; if the retry's output still matches isGitLabAuthFailure, gitLabAuth is thrown with `detail: failure.failureMessage` (the retry's), otherwise control falls through to the --recover check (lines 401-419). The final error is creationFailed(failure.failureMessage).

isGitLabAuthFailure: lowercased output+errorOutput contains "401" or "unauthorized", or "authentication" together with one of "failed", "expired", "invalid", "required". MR URL = first match of regex https://\S+ in output + errorOutput.

gitLabAuth errorDescription: "GitLab refused the login (401 Unauthorized) for <host>: the token glab signs in with is missing or expired.

<detail>

Sign back in with `glab auth login --hostname <host>` (or export a valid GITLAB_TOKEN), then ask for the merge again. The branch `<branch>` is already pushed, so the team's work is safe."

hydraWork: reported = unmerged turns' touchedPaths + for each team head with mergedAt == nil and no landing patchPath/error: its landing files and its timeline tool edits (live runtime entries, or Storage.decodeDocument off main), anchored to the head's checkout (copy paths mapped back); + the lead's own tool edits in unmerged turns. Paths not build output are split into inside (relative) and outside. Checkout sweep (sweepsCheckout only) adds files changed since the first unmerged turn's baseCheckpoint that were not already dirty at that checkpoint and are not sibling reservations. Blocking claims are subtracted (and remembered as claimed); build output, ignored paths, and missing untracked paths removed. turnIDs/headIDs exclude any turn/head touching a claimed path; held maps claimed path -> owner name. Precisely (lines 568-576): the sweep runs only when sweepsCheckout and `turns.first?.baseCheckpoint` exists; `alreadyDirty = git.changedPaths(from: "HEAD", to: base)` compares the CURRENT HEAD with that checkpoint (not the dirty set at checkpoint time, so once HEAD has moved since the checkpoint, files committed in between also count as "theirs"); `now = git.captureTree()`; `changedSince = git.changedPaths(from: base, to: now)`; fresh = changedSince not in alreadyDirty, minus sibling reservations. If any of the three git calls throws (`try?`), the whole sweep is skipped silently.

siblingOwnedPaths: other threads in the same project, not this lead or its team. Heads: mergedAt == nil and (running or parent canStillMerge); rankedOut only when completed and the parent ranks after this lead and is finished-idle-eligible; reserves landing files under parent title (or head title). Chats with live runtime: rankedOut = ranks after and finished-idle-eligible; reserves touchedPaths of unmerged turns where canStillMerge(other) or the turn is not completed. Owner name = chat title. hydraIsFinishedIdleEligible(lead) (lines 679-684): `guard hydraIsOn(lead), let live = existingRuntime(for: lead.id) else { return false }`, then `guard live.isReadyForHydraMerge, !live.isHydraMerging, !hydraHasPendingLanding(lead.id) else { return false }`, then `return canStillMerge(lead)`. A lead with no live runtime is never eligible, so its claims are never ranked out.

hydraRanksAfter: lead.id.uuidString > other.uuidString (the earliest UUID string wins). canStillMerge: live runtime not idle or merging -> true; else requires not archived, hydraIsOn, updatedAt within 3 days; without a live runtime -> lead.lastStatus == .completed; with one -> last turn completed and (unmerged turns non-empty or landed unmerged head work). hydraHasPendingLanding: any unmerged team head with non-empty landing files and !landing.landed.

syncDefaultBranch: remote = "origin/<target>"; requires fetch success and head ancestor of remote; other changed paths must not be dirty; presentPaths splits kept/gone; HEAD must still equal head; then resetSoft(remote), resetIndex(ownPaths), checkoutPaths(kept), removePaths(gone); any throw -> false.

commitMessage: text engine via textEngine(preferring: lead.provider) with summary lines "A|D|M <path>" and settings.commitInstructions; fallback = lead title (or "Hydra: the team's work" when title == ChatThread.untitled), blank line, "- <persona>: <task singleLine limit 100>" for every head of `hydraTeam(of: lead.id)` with a non-empty task (every non-archived head of the lead, including heads merged by earlier jobs, not just this merge's heads), joined by "\n" and trimmed.

mergeRequestBody: "Opened by Droppy Code once its Hydra team finished.", blank; then, only when non-empty, "## Heads" with "- **<persona>**: <task singleLine limit 120>" for every head of `hydraTeam(of: lead.id)` with a non-empty task (all non-archived heads, including heads merged by earlier jobs), plus " (1 file|N files)" only when `landing` exists and `landing.files` is non-empty, followed by a blank line; then, only when a non-empty reply exists, "## The lead's summary" with the last assistant reply of the merged turns trimmed, cut to 2,000 characters + "…", followed by a blank line; then "## Files" with "- `<path>` (+<a> −<d>)" (no trailing blank line); joined by "\n".

hydraBranchName: title ("team" when title == ChatThread.untitled) lowercased, non letter/number -> "-", "--" collapsed, "-" trimmed, cut to 40 then trimmed; suffix = `String(UUID().uuidString.lowercased().prefix(6))` from a FRESH random UUID (line 807), not from the lead's id; result "hydra/<slug or 'team'>-<suffix>". A new random name is made each time mergeHydraProject runs with ownBranch, so a retried merge pushes a different branch.
pathsWithConflictMarkers: skips files larger than 4,000,000 bytes or unreadable; prepends 0x0A and requires both "\n<<<<<<< " and "\n>>>>>>> ".

note(): appends title + "\n" + body under the spent hydraMergeNoteID; if NSApp.isActive and the lead is selected, nothing more; otherwise hasUnread = true, updateDockBadge(), and if settings.notifyWhenFinished notify(threadID:, title: lead.title, body: title).

Doc comment (lines 372-373) says "Squash and source-branch removal are explicit for GitLab team merges", but the arguments contain only "--squash-before-merge"; no source-branch-removal flag is passed in this file.
